      public Buyer updateDetails(String buyerId, String fullName, String residenceHall)
      Updates the buyer's full name and residence hall.
      Parameters:
      buyerId - buyer
      fullName - new full name
      residenceHall - new residence hall; blank means not given
      Returns:
      the updated buyer

    • changePassword

      public void changePassword(String userId, String currentPassword, String newPassword, String confirmPassword)
      Changes a user's password after checking the current one.
      Parameters:
      userId - user
      currentPassword - current password
      newPassword - new password meeting the team rules
      confirmPassword - must equal the new password
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the current password is wrong or the new one breaks a rule
